# EEC1: Math Rendering Fixture

**Preamble:** Bring a calculator; the divider network uses $6\,\Omega$ resistors and a $\mu$F capacitor.

## Problem 1: Resistor network with $V_{out}$

The bench kit holds six resistors of $6\,\Omega$, a pair $\{3\,\Omega, 5\,\Omega\}$, and one 50% tolerance part. Underscores_in_prose, an & ampersand, a # hash and a C:\temp path must all survive the .tex escape.

### (a) Divider ratio [60 pts] [ai-graded:medium]
Show that $\frac{17}{7}$ follows from $V_x$ and $V_{out}$, then evaluate $e^{-0.2(t-8)}$ at $t=8$. The propagation constant is $3 \times 10^{8}$ m/s and the skin depth is $\delta_s \approx 2.7 \times 10^{-6}$ m. Display form: $$V_{out} = V_{in}\frac{R_2}{R_1 + R_2}$$

> grading_prompt: Required elements: (1) the ratio $\frac{17}{7}$ stated explicitly; (2) the $6\,\Omega$ value carried through. Award full marks for responses that correctly address both elements.
> Award partial credit for responses that address only one element.
> Award no credit for responses that address neither element.

### (b) Bench photograph [40 pts] [image:2]
Photograph the assembled board so the measured $6\,\Omega$ reading is legible on the meter face.

> grader_note: Both leads visible; the meter must read $6\,\Omega \pm 5\%$.
